narr: During the morning and early afternoon hours of July 1st, heavy rainfall yielded flash flooding across much of Johnson County. A swath of 3 to 6 of rain with isolated locations up to 7 fell within about a 3 hour time period from about 930 am to 1230 pm.
ev: Numerous reports of flooded roadways and water rescues across Johnson County between 10:30 am and 12 pm CDT.
lsr: Public reported that road was impassible due to water overflowing from creek. Ongoing heavy rainfall at time of report.
Tomahawk Creek at Roe Avenue (TCRK1) reached flood stage at 1130 am.
Several reports of water rescues in eastern Johnson County between 1130 and 1140 am.
Multiple water assists and stalled vehicles near 124th and Nall. Time estimated from radar.
